title: Space FPS game - will not continue working on this
author: Defiant-Balance-7982
selftext:
Hi all,  
  
Back in September, I started my first Unity project with Claude Opus: **Hivefront** a sci-fi shooter inspired by the late release announcement of the Starcraft shooter.

I’ve experimented with a few other game projects since then, but I won’t be continuing this one. The realistic art and 3D modelling turned out to be to hard with AI, especially getting assets to look consistent and work well together in-game.

I didn’t want it to just sit on my hard drive, so I put together this short showcase of the levels. I also recorded some of the development sandboxes I used for testing shooting, movement, sand simulation, and modular assets.

It’s an unfinished prototype with plenty of rough edges, but I’m glad I gave it a go and wanted to share where it ended up.

  
Unity  
Claude AI Opus  
Meshy.ai for 3D
